title: hexfold: a SMILES-like notation for curved sp2 carbon as defect placement on a hexagonal lattice
description: hexfold is an interchange notation and Python library for curved sp2 carbon allotropes (nanotubes, cones, sheets, fullerenes, caps, nanobuds and their junctions) expressed as defect placement on a hexagonal lattice. A .hx text file is parsed into a topology-only Net with stable atom IDs, checked against Euler/curvature counting and valence rules, canonicalised, and optionally rendered as a rubber-stick preview model. Coordinates are derived, never stored. The format specification is SPEC.md.
